title: GO: open or accreted land
why: Historic mangrove (H) that Dynamic World now reads as bare, grass or shrub. Note 3b class 8 is the open and accreted GO class. It is a candidate for natural regeneration or planting after an elevation check, not a pond.

title: STOP: open water on former existing mangrove
why: First-pass class 3 (existing mangrove, conserve) replaced by class 2 where Dynamic World is water in at least 90 percent of 2024-2025 observations, and the cell is neither a Murray tidal flat nor a Step 2 pond. Nationally this override is 1,144 ha. The site shows where the STOP open-water rule overrides conserve.

title: CAUTION: tidal flat
why: Murray Global Intertidal Change (2014-2016) marks the cell as tidal flat, and Dynamic World now reads bare or water. Note 3b class 4 is CAUTION: no planting on mudflats; natural recruitment only after a hydrology check.
